body:
WHAT
A user describes an addon in plain words; the `generate_addon` frame runs one inference call that writes a complete addon Markdown file, validates its frontmatter (a `---` block with `name:` and `description:`) and non-empty body, retrying up to 3 times with the validator error, and emits an `addon_draft`. The user may edit the draft; the `install_addon` frame re-validates it, writes `.magentra/addons/<slug>.md`, reloads the addon roster in place and announces `addons_updated`, so `/<name>` and the Addon tool work immediately.

WHY
Without validation a chatty or malformed model reply would be saved as an addon that never loads; without the in-place reload the new addon would be invisible until the next /clear or restart.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — Engine.startAddonGeneration(), Engine.generateAddon() (ADDON_AUTHOR_ROLE, buildAddonPrompt(), repairAddonText(), stripCodeFence(), validateAddonText()), Engine.installAddon() (filename regex `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*\.md$`, validateAddonText, writeFileSync, reloadAddons(), emitAddonsUpdated()), Engine.reloadAddons(). engine/core/src/config/frontmatter.ts — parseFrontmatter() used by validateAddonText and by the loader.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a FakeProvider whose first turn returns 'Here is your addon:\n---\nname: my-tool\ndescription: d\n---\nbody', generate_addon emits addon_draft ok:true with text starting at the `---` line and suggestedFilename 'my-tool.md' (preamble stripped by repairAddonText).
2. With a FakeProvider returning text without frontmatter three times, generate_addon emits addon_draft ok:false whose error contains 'after 3 attempts', and the provider received exactly 3 requests with the second and third containing the validator feedback.
3. generate_addon with an empty description emits addon_draft ok:false immediately and the FakeProvider receives no request.
4. install_addon with filename 'Bad Name.md' or with text lacking `description:` emits a non-fatal error frame and writes no file.
5. install_addon with a valid draft writes .magentra/addons/<slug>.md, emits addons_updated whose commands include `/<slug>` and whose addons include the name, and a following slash_command `/<slug>` starts a turn (FakeProvider request contains the addon body) instead of 'Unknown command'.
